name: Duolingo
tagline: Language learning platform with unofficial community APIs
description: Duolingo is a popular language-learning platform. There is no known official public developer API for third-party apps; community reverse-engineered endpoints and unofficial wrappers exist for user progress, streak, and vocabulary data.

auth.details: No official public API authentication. Unofficial clients typically use session cookies or JWT from login.

use_cases: fetch a learner's public profile and streak
look up XP and language progress for a username
